title: Add a real, read-only System Monitor to the paired-device workspace.
changes: Add a graphite/sage System Monitor with resource history, per-core CPU charts, read-only process inventory, network interfaces, mounted volumes, thermal readings and local event history.

Sample actual system counters: per-core CPU times via Node OS telemetry; Linux receive/transmit byte deltas, readable kernel temperatures and bounded mounted disk volumes. Unsupported operating systems and unavailable sensors explicitly report unknown measurements.
Limit process names, sensor identifiers, interfaces and filesystem metadata at the owner-authenticated diagnostics boundary. Hide command arguments and reject unknown executable labels.
Poll only the currently selected online paired device; honor telemetry opt-out, tab visibility, request deadlines and rate limits. Keep the existing owner and capability checks.

Verify the update on ASUS with real system measurements, isolated desktop/mobile Chromium screenshots, regression tests, source-size and security checks. Require a coordinated public runtime package release and exact-head self-hosted CI before private merge and production promotion.
